title: AMD action: getupdatedpatients
description: List patients whose record changed at or after an ISO 8601 since timestamp (delta-sync feed). Returns since, limit, count, and a patients list. patients rows: patient_id, chart_number, lastupdated. Narrow tracker for nightly-sync workflows; call getdemographic per id to hydrate the full record.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; AMD returns patients modified at or after.
